name: ramp-one-way-traffic
description: One-way ramps: a player picks a built ramp's traffic direction in the inspector. A ramp is dug, the player clicks it in the scene, and the inspector offers a Traffic action beside Widen. Each click steps the ramp to the next setting: two-way, then down only (vehicles only drive down it), then up only. Pairing a down ramp with an up ramp keeps trucks from meeting head-on; the route preference itself is asserted by unit tests (PathfindingRampFlow). Contract for console-api state: builtRampFlow (the first built ramp's direction: both, down or up).

steps.description: Staffed vehicles come unmanned (#551) - crew rock_digger #3 with driver #4 before ordering excavation work. Same bootstrap as ramp-width-select-widen.json.

steps.command: build_ramp origin:20,20 direction:south length:11 depth:6 width:3
steps.description: Player arms the ramp tool, sets depth 6 and width 3, drags the 11-tile corridor and confirms (the same path as ramp-width-select-widen.json).
Wait for every dig_ramp_segment to land; the finished ramp is recorded as a BuiltRamp, two-way.
Player clicks the dug ramp in the scene (viewport centre after a near top-down focusTile on the corridor midpoint). The inspector shows the ramp with a Traffic action.
Player clicks Traffic: the two-way ramp becomes down only. The setting takes effect at once, with no tick.
Player clicks Traffic again: the ramp becomes up only.
